title: Can I participate in my child's occupational therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Parent Participation in Child's Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover the significant role of active parent participation in a child's occupational therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: Absolutely, your active participation is not only welcomed but strongly encouraged! At Pinnacle Blooms, we acknowledge that parents and family members play a significant role in a child's developmental journey. By involving you in the therapy sessions, we ensure that the strategies used can be effectively implemented as part of your child's daily routine, maintaining continuity in fostering progress.
